_meta.band_rule: median of the source's row-tag counts, +/-15%; needs >= 3 runs; a source whose median is 0 is labelled no-structure instead of being asserted as a stable zero.
_meta.drift_event_rule: one event per (source, run) where a row count left the pinned band and was a robust outlier, or the source has never produced a parsable table, or its required marker went missing. check_drift.py recomputes the same set and fails if the two ever disagree, so the published page cannot lag the alarm.
_meta.freshness_rule: check_drift.py --ci fails when the newest capture is older than 30.0h (the observed schedule slipped by up to 23.44h, so a 26h threshold would alarm on normal Actions behaviour)
_meta.rule: Every number here is a count over the committed manifest. No page was fetched and no value was parsed. The capture records bytes, hashes, statuses, byte counts and HTML element counts; it does not record what any page says, and this desk does not pretend otherwise.

gate_value_level_delta.why: The capture stores bytes, hashes and element counts. No player value is parsed, so a value-level delta cannot be computed from it by anyone, including this repository.

delta_quality.reading: Every transition the capture labelled 'changed' is a byte change. The share of those whose structural signature did not move is the rate at which the only change detector in the pipeline reports an event that no reader can find on the page. A surprise signal built on it would be pure noise, which is why the band below is computed on row counts instead.
